study.method: Private model-assisted contextual study with exact target quotation checks and separate contextual review

repairs: Reaction fixture now preserves authenticated older source refetches
Measure actual generation context rather than redundant preflight fetches
Qualified graph status/date contract prevents observed permanent-allegiance overclaim
Native verification has four seconds per source and six seconds total
Shared image/human nodes survive removal of a different connected episode
limitations: Three synthetic paraphrases of one retained concept; not independent held-out human exchanges
Reviewer uses the same runtime model; no human rubric review
Not continuous graph population or model distillation
Historical images are connected but unstudied; no historical image-dependent personal inference
Native peers, threads, full history and richer entities/humor remain future work
